charts.title: K2-33 b: orbits around K2-33
charts.description: The orbits of K2-33's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-33 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Mann et al. 2016 (2016AJ....152...61M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname MANN_ET_AL__2016): P 5.424865 d

charts.title: K2-33 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-33 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (91) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 49040478, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 44 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 109 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 16-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 44 min late; 16-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 36 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
